description: Defines the ParamConverterManager class responsible for managing request parameter converters in Drupal, including adding converters, retrieving them, setting route parameter converters, and converting parameters using registered converters.

classes.name: ParamConverterManager
classes.description: Manages converter services for converting request parameters to full objects within Drupal.

methods.name: addConverter
methods.description: Adds a converter service to the manager, associating it with an ID.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves a registered converter by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: setRouteParameterConverters
methods.description: Sets appropriate converters for route parameters based on registered converters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts route parameters to full objects using registered converters, throws exception if conversion fails.
